goal: Determine whether a low-cost bacterial-cellulose sorbent remains selective, buoyant, retrievable and mechanically recoverable under saltwater and controlled dynamic-water conditions before any petroleum or open-water field claim is considered.

supported: Sorbent performance must be evaluated for oil-over-water selectivity, retention, buoyancy, retrieval and end-of-life handling.
Pads, sheets, pillows and booms are recognized oil-sorbent product architectures.
Mechanical squeezing/pressing is a valid recovery concept to test for oil-loaded oleophilic materials.
not_yet_supported: SCOBY-D0 is ready for real marine oil spills.
Laboratory g/g values will survive waves, salinity, debris or viscous petroleum.
Any hydrophobic treatment is environmentally safe before leachate/ecotoxicity testing.
A 1 m boom cartridge is ready for deployment before pad-level gates pass.

stage_0_coupon_gate.purpose: Finish the already frozen GREEN vs BLACK -> D0-D3 -> 50x50 coupon screen before marine scale-up.
stage_0_coupon_gate.matrix: 2 tea feeds x D0-D3 x matched replicates
stage_0_coupon_gate.advance_rule: Advance only the best one or two branches by joint dry BC yield, oil uptake, water uptake, selectivity, retention, integrity, reproducibility and estimated process cost. Tea identity alone cannot win.

stage_1_marine_pad.architecture: RETRIEVABLE_PAD; optional inert containment mesh permitted if it is weighed and tracked separately

phase_M1A_static_matrix.objective: Measure salinity penalty before adding motion.

phase_M1B_dynamic_matrix.objective: Expose the winner to controlled motion and retrieval losses.
phase_M1B_dynamic_matrix.rule: Record motion settings and exposure time so every sample sees the same history.
forbidden: crude-oil or fuel testing outside an appropriately controlled laboratory
discarding fragments into drains or the environment

stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G1_UPTAKE: Median surrogate-oil uptake >= 10 g/g in artificial seawater.
stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G2_SELECTIVITY: Median oil/water uptake ratio >= 5 in artificial seawater.
stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G3_RETENTION: At least 85% of initially absorbed surrogate oil remains after standardized retrieval and passive drain.
stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G4_RETRIEVAL: At least 99% dry-equivalent sorbent mass is physically retrieved; no visible hazardous fragmentation.
stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G5_PRESS_RECOVERY: At least 60% of initially absorbed surrogate oil is recoverable by the standardized single press if closed-loop recovery is claimed.
stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G6_SALINITY_ROBUSTNESS: Lead branch retains at least 80% of matched freshwater oil-uptake/selectivity performance in artificial seawater.
stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G7_DYNAMIC_ROBUSTNESS: Lead branch retains at least 80% of matched static-marine performance under the frozen dynamic exposure.
stage_1_promotion_gates.M1_G8_REPLICATION: Lead result reproduced in at least two independent BC production batches.
stage_1_promotion_gates.note: These are internal engineering promotion thresholds, not regulatory standards.

stage_2_boom_cartridge.design_reason: Containment sleeve prevents BC fragments from entering the water and turns the sorbent into a single recoverable object.
initial_module_logic: Use multiple removable BC pads/segments rather than one monolithic meter-long sponge.
Track each insert by sample ID and dry mass.
Measure saturated mass so lifting load is known.
Retrieve the full cartridge before pressing; do not squeeze in open water.
Press in a contained station and collect the entire oil/water liquid fraction for phase separation.
stage_2_boom_cartridge.M2_gate: A 1 m cartridge may advance only if it remains positively buoyant, fully retrievable, contains its BC, preserves >=80% of pad-level g/g performance and has a measured cost-per-recovered-oil advantage worth pursuing against the reference control.

cost_down_gate.principle: Optimize recovered oil per unit cost, not publication-grade maximum g/g.
cost_down_gate.winner_rule: Select by measured marine performance, recovery, retrieval integrity, batch reproducibility, energy use and cost per kg recovered oil.

mirror_check.promotion_rule: No field claim until the same critical edges pass in measured forward execution and reverse audit.

regulatory_and_method_anchors.resource: Application of Sorbents and Solidifiers for Oil Spills

next_action: Execute Stage 0 coupon gate if not already complete. Then fabricate 100x100 mm pads from the top one or two branches and run M1A fresh-vs-artificial-seawater static tests with vegetable oil before any dynamic or petroleum work.
